001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.inventory;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
005
006/**
007 * Fire when shop inventory space/stock calculating.
008 */
009public class ShopInventoryCalculateEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
010
011  private final Shop shop;
012  private final int space;
013  private final int stock;
014
015  public ShopInventoryCalculateEvent(final Shop shop, final int space, final int stock) {
016
017    this.shop = shop;
018    this.space = space;
019    this.stock = stock;
020  }
021
022  /**
023   * Gets the shop that inventory has been calculated
024   *
025   * @return The shop
026   */
027  public Shop getShop() {
028
029    return shop;
030  }
031
032  /**
033   * Getting the inventory space
034   *
035   * @return The inventory space (-1 if not get calculated)
036   */
037  public int getSpace() {
038
039    return space;
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Getting the inventory stock
044   *
045   * @return The inventory stock (-1 if not get calculated)
046   */
047  public int getStock() {
048
049    return stock;
050  }
051
052  @Override
053  public boolean equals(final Object o) {
054
055    if(o == this) return true;
056    if(!(o instanceof ShopInventoryCalculateEvent)) return false;
057    final ShopInventoryCalculateEvent other = (ShopInventoryCalculateEvent)o;
058    if(!other.canEqual((Object)this)) return false;
059    if(!super.equals(o)) return false;
060    if(this.getSpace() != other.getSpace()) return false;
061    if(this.getStock() != other.getStock()) return false;
062    final Object thisShop = this.getShop();
063    final Object otherShop = other.getShop();
064    if(thisShop == null? otherShop != null : !thisShop.equals(otherShop)) return false;
065    return true;
066  }
067
068  protected boolean canEqual(final Object other) {
069
070    return other instanceof ShopInventoryCalculateEvent;
071  }
072
073  @Override
074  public int hashCode() {
075
076    final int PRIME = 59;
077    int result = super.hashCode();
078    result = result * PRIME + this.getSpace();
079    result = result * PRIME + this.getStock();
080    final Object shopValue = this.getShop();
081    result = result * PRIME + (shopValue == null? 43 : shopValue.hashCode());
082    return result;
083  }
084
085  @Override
086  public String toString() {
087
088    return "ShopInventoryCalculateEvent(shop=" + this.getShop() + ", space=" + this.getSpace() + ", stock=" + this.getStock() + ")";
089  }
090}
